acknowledgement.description: Whether and how the worker acknowledged the induction, plus a reference to the signed form or attachment.

approved_at.description: When the induction was approved, and by whom in `attributes`.

attributes.description: Every remaining form answer, keyed by the tenant's own question text, including the media/media-URL, vehicle-monitoring and one-off answers.

employment_start_date.description: Planned or actual start date for the onboarded worker.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The accounting period the record falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

form_id.description: The source form template id — which induction/onboarding form produced the record.

form_title.description: Human-readable template title; the form family the record came from.

inducting_site_or_company.description: The site or company the induction was conducted for.

induction_valid_until.description: Expiry or lapse date of the induction/card.

occurred_at.description: When the induction/onboarding form was submitted; the event time and the retention clock.

site_access_blocked.description: Whether an incomplete induction blocks site sign-in, and the stated reasons.

source_system.description: Originating system; `ASSIGNAR` today, SignOnSite or Hammertech if ever bound.

worker.description: The worker whose induction/onboarding this is; the required subject anchor.
